before: 3B001 and 3B090 are the entries in the US export control list that cover chipmaking equipment. They are written as process specifications, such as an etch tool that cuts sideways or a deposition tool that reaches 200-to-1 holes.
after: 3B001 is the main entry in the US export control list for chipmaking equipment. It is written as process specifications, such as an etch tool that cuts sideways or a deposition tool that coats holes more than 200 times deeper than they are wide. BIS created 3B090 in October 2022 and folded it into 3B001 and 3B002 in October 2023 (88 FR 73424).
note: 3B090 no longer exists in the CCL.
